contract: (18 closed vm_cp views of origin/main 53b6c93ee, one slot each)
schema_note: v2 (10-13): judged on the pair equation with insertion-compensated clock entry; v1 judged each side against 0.2 T

rule.reading: die clock at tile X clock pin = phi - R_X (R = mean boundary-register insertion, the sign-off reference); hop A -> B: o_A + w L + s_B <= T - U - SKEW with o = clk->pin - R, s = setup@pin + R; per tile C = o + s, reach = (T - U - SKEW - C) / w; the sign-off SDC (0.2 T outside) only proves o, s <= signoff_allow each

die_clock.rule: clock at tile X clock pin = phi - R_X (+ common trunk); the branch to X carries R_max - R_X of added delay

ocv_skew_ps.note: every clock pin is matched to the deepest tile, so each side of every hop carries >= R_max of non-shared insertion: 2 x OCV x R_max of the die skew budget is spent before the die tree itself

ff_tt_tracking.note: R_ff / R_tt per tile; a fixed-ratio delay line misses the span by this much at the other corner

setup_worst_pair.note: potential pairs among the audited cells (connectivity not resolved); common phase adds R_src - R_dst to the pair

fix: output pin register missing or far: 1310 bits (ne, se), worst ne leaves 392 ps after the latest boundary clock = 212 ps over a pin flop (logic, or ~279 um of wire, after the flop): add / move the output register to the pin

input pin register missing or far: 589 bits (tap, cfgi), worst tap needs 301 ps before the earliest boundary clock = 151 ps over a pin flop: first flop ~198 um (or logic) behind the pin: register at the pin

output pin register missing or far: 15 bits (rd), worst rd leaves 272 ps after the latest boundary clock = 92 ps over a pin flop (logic, or ~122 um of wire, after the flop): add / move the output register to the pin
boundary clock spread 95 ps > 80: put the boundary registers on one balanced sub-root (or split the root); every ps is inside o + s (1.3 um of reach per ps)

output pin register missing or far: 1 bits (cfg), worst cfg leaves 257 ps after the latest boundary clock = 77 ps over a pin flop (logic, or ~101 um of wire, after the flop): add / move the output register to the pin

output pin register missing or far: 21 bits (rd), worst rd leaves 244 ps after the latest boundary clock = 64 ps over a pin flop (logic, or ~85 um of wire, after the flop): add / move the output register to the pin

cross_tile_min_delay.note: potential pairs (connectivity between view cells is not resolved): L_min(src) - H_max(dst) < 100 ps
